order_type.description: Alias for `type`; either may be used. When neither is sent, the type is read from the prices: `limit_price` gives a limit, `stop_price` a stop, both a stop_limit, `trail_pct` a trailing stop, and none a market order. An explicit type always wins, including `market`.

limit_price.description: The most you will pay on a buy, the least you will take on a sell. Implies `limit` when no type is sent.

stop_price.description: Implies `stop` when no type is sent, or `stop_limit` alongside `limit_price`.

trail_pct.description: Implies `trailing_stop` when no type is sent.
